notes.title: Pre-Next Fest event
notes.content: [p]Foobar Zero is going to participate in Steam Next Fest (Oct 13th to 20th)![/p][p]We want to reward those who've stuck around with us during the beta, so we've decided to make a pre-fest event! Every weekend before Next Fest, the servers will open for a day. Additionaly, we will host playtests more frequently during this time, so you can try out the game with us![/p][p][/p][p]If you reach certain levels before the Next Fest launches, you will receive rewards when the game launches.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949614/160263dcffb57c26019bc87eb1ba22a946ccabea.png"][/img][/p][p]We are so grateful for every one of you![/p]

notes.title: Participating in Steam TPS Fest 2025!
notes.content: [p]We are very excited to announce that Foobar Zero will be participating in [b]Steam TPS Fest 2025[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]During this week, the servers will be open and you can jump in to the game at any time! If you don't find a room, there is also bot support, so don't be shy, open up a room, and maybe someone will join![/p][p][/p][p]To participate, press Request access on the playtest app:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2904650/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Join our Discord server to find people to play with, and provide feedback for the developers![/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FxWFxGhAt45" style="button"]Join Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: Open Weekend
notes.content: [p]We are exhibiting Foobar Zero at the local Comic Con this weekend![/p][p]To celebrate we are [b]opening the servers for 2 days[/b], where you can play freely! Lately we have been adding a lot of exciting features, like bot support, spectators, ping system, additional character customizations and more![/p][p]Join our Discord server to find people to play with, and share your thoughts about the game![/p][p]If you're interested, click the Request Access button to participate in the playtest![/p]
